task_instance: Time-block a realistic workday: audit a raw task list for shallow-work overspend, build an energy-first time-blocked schedule (deep work first, 4-hour deep cap, shallow batched into <=2 windows, buffers, fixed lunch), then log a completed focus session and check weekly progress/streak.
evidence: The skill's referenced scripts/shallow_work_auditor.py, scripts/time_block_planner.py, and scripts/focus_session_logger.py did not exist in the fetched skill source (only SKILL.md and LICENSE were present), so I implemented all three stdlib-only Python scripts from the detailed spec in SKILL.md and ran the full 4-step workflow in the work directory. Step 1: `python3 scripts/shallow_work_auditor.py --task "Write investor update:60" --task "Email triage:45" --task "Analyze churn cohort:90:deep" --budget 50` classified tasks deep/shallow, computed shallow share 23.1% <= 50% budget, printed the recent-graduate forcing question, exit 0; a second run with --budget 30 and heavier shallow load correctly printed 'OVER-BUDGET' and exited 2. Step 2: `python3 scripts/time_block_planner.py --start 08:30 --end 17:00 --lunch 12:30 --task "Write product spec:120:deep" --task "Analyze churn cohort:90:deep" --task "Email sweep:30:shallow" --task "Team sync:20:shallow"` produced a full schedule (deep blocks first at 08:30-10:30 and 10:40-12:10, lunch 12:30-13:30, two shallow batches at 13:30-14:00 and 14:10-14:30, exit 0, finished well before 17:00). Confirmed the two required refusals: a 300-min deep load against a compressed 08:30-10:00 window each correctly triggered 'REFUSED' with exit code 2 (deep-cap overflow naming the deferred task, and shallow-overflow naming the dropped task). Step 3: `python3 scripts/focus_session_logger.py log --minutes 120 --label "Write product spec"` and a second log call wrote atomically to focus_ledger.json (verified via `cat focus_ledger.json`, containing both JSON entries with date/timestamp/minutes/label); `status --target 15` reported '3.5h logged vs target 15.0h, BEHIND by 11.5h'; `streak` reported '1 consecutive day(s) with at least one session'. All deliverables (audit output, time-blocked schedule, JSON ledger, status/streak) were produced and verified in /tmp/.../exec_div/alirezarezvani__claude-skills__deep-work@developer-sandbox/ (scripts/shallow_work_auditor.py, scripts/time_block_planner.py, scripts/focus_session_logger.py, focus_ledger.json). This is a pure reasoning+stdlib-Python skill with no external APIs, no network, and no credentials needed, so the core intent (turning a raw task list into a protected, energy-first time-blocked day with a measured weekly ledger) is fully achievable in this runtime.
